lines: What if, one morning, every gun in the world just vanished?
Over a billion guns, gone in an instant.
A police officer grabs an empty holster.
Some people celebrate in the streets.
Others feel unsafe, and stores sell out of bats and locks.
The good news: gun deaths, about a quarter million a year, drop toward zero.
The bad news: crime continues, with knives.
And factories could build guns again.
So, would the world rebuild them, or stay gun free?
